item.title: How to Build and Host a Website with Hugo
item.description: This is a concise, step-by-step guide on how to build a website - just like this one - with Hugo, and host it on Github. Follow the steps and check out the links for further explanation on each component. This guide is made for non-experts, because I found most Hugo tutorials utterly useless and sparse for people new to computers web-development. It might look daunting at first to go through all these steps below, but the reward is that once you get it right, updating and maintaining your website will be incredibly fast and easy.

item.title: About
item.description: Hi! I’m a PhD candidate in Computer Science at Drexel University and a Research Assistant in the SOAR Lab. My research focuses on trustworthy AI for software engineering. I investigate how large language models and AI agents reason about software, and develop methods to improve their reliability, interpretability, and performance in automated program repair and code generation, and developer-facing AI tools. More broadly, I’m interested in building trustworthy AI systems through empirical evaluation and model analysis.
